messages:
sam: Heads-up — scheduling RFC review this Wed 10:00am PT (45m). Need to slot 6 authors into ~6–7m each + small buffers. Reviewers: please confirm availability. Authors: pls upload pre-reads by EOD Mon.

maya: I'm in for Wed 10. Can take Storage + infra. Will read pre-reads Mon.

kai: I can do Runtime + canary notes. Request: put Runtime earlier — it's blocking API work.

drew: I can cover API and reranker (if placed later). Quick ask to authors: add 1–2 "what to expect" bullets in PR desc.

harper: OOO Tue morning, back by Tue 3pm. EOD Mon preread deadline works. Can review infra if needed.

sam: Proposed agenda by dependency (to minimize rework): Storage -> Runtime -> API -> Reranker -> Observability -> Docs. Thoughts?

maya: +1. Also ask authors to include 3 short test-cases/examples in the pre-read. Makes discussion concrete.

kai: Tiny ask — reserve a 5m buffer after Runtime for canary/rollout Qs or it'll spill into later slots.

sam: Good call. I'll add a 5m buffer after Runtime and tighten others to 6m. Updated plan: 

```
10:00 - 10:03 quick sync + roll call
10:03 - 10:12 Storage (author A)
10:12 - 10:20 Runtime (author B) + 5m canary Qs
10:25 - 10:31 API (author C)
10:31 - 10:37 Reranker (author D)
10:37 - 10:43 Observability (author E)
10:43 - 10:48 Docs + wrap
```

maya: Looks good. Sam, can you ping authors to upload pre-reads + include PR links?

sam: Will do now. @authors please add pre-reads and 2-3 callouts in PR description ("what to expect", key risks, test cases). If blocked, reply here.

drew: Quick note — reviewers, can you pre-assign yourselves on the calendar event? I'll mark myself on Storage and API.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "RFC Review — Wed 10:00am PT" — attendees: sam, maya, kai, drew, harper, authors. Link: https://calendar.example/evt/abc123

harper: Got the invite. Can we add a small 'read-by' tracker (like :eyes:) per pre-read so we know who's read which?

sam: Good idea — I'll add a checklist in the event with author names + reviewer :eyes: checkbox.

maya: One more: if an author can't make their slot, please attach a 2-3min recording summarizing the RFC. Saves re-slotting.

kai: Agreed. Authors, upload a short video or a brief note if you can't attend.

sam: Thanks all. I'll follow up tomorrow with a final roster + PR links. If nobody objects, I'll lock the agenda in 24h.
